definitions.full: H2097. zo זֹוּ id quod זֹה (q. v.): only Hosea 7:16 b לַעָגָּם זוֺ this (i.e. the falling by the sword, v a ) is their derision; and (as, relative) Psa 132:12 זֹוֺ וְעֵדֹ֫תִ֖י and my testimony which . . . (neglecting the accentuation: see De, and compare the remark under זֶה 5 ).
